_comment: The `meta` theme's text (content sets R3). Every line is true of every world the pack can be used in: it names only what every generated world has (rooms, exits, checks, items, rules, a seed). {placeholder} templates are filled at PLAY by the substrate that shows them (the text adventure's templating.js): {destinationRegion} in a gate's lines, {item} in a check's.

strings.meta:concept/guardian/blocked: The Gate stays shut. Its rule is one item, Progressive Sword, and you do not have it. Come back with it and the way to {destinationRegion} opens.
strings.meta:concept/guardian/passedWith: The Gate checks for Progressive Sword and finds it. That is its whole rule, so it opens. The way to {destinationRegion} is clear.
strings.meta:concept/sword/checkMessage: This location is a check. You checked it and received {item}. A rule that asks only for this item now passes.
strings.meta:concept/swim/checkMessage: This location is a check. You checked it and received {item}. A rule that asks only for this item now passes.
